## `get_full_project_path`

*Available in [R](#get_full_project_path-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    Gets the currently set full path to the project from .ProjData/Data.dcf

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    get_full_project_path()

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
    <h4>Returns</h4>

    full path to project
